page_description: Spa-shop! Create and maintain a json file driven gallery / shop single page app site easily.
page_content:
Welcome to the SPA-Shop!

A friend was impressed with my website and was hoping to get something similar built for himself for under $1000. I started building this in an attempt to help him out. I know it's dumb. I told him to just get a shopify shop, but no one listens to me.

It's based on the wacky tool I built to manage the JSON files I use to keep my own site running without reliance on databases or shopify.


A thing.
